videos.title: 晶片如何製成？ASML Nanoland 第 6 集
videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「半導體製程工藝」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Semiconductor Fabrication. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「建立 CMOS 剖面層序」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Build the CMOS cross-section stack requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.

guides.title: 把晶片剖面變成可檢查的製程依存圖
guides.titleEn: Turn a chip cross-section into a checkable process dependency graph
guides.concept: 製程不只是工序清單。每一步必須取得特定的表面、材料或圖案狀態，並留下下一步能使用的結果。同一種沉積或清洗可在不同層重複出現，目的卻不同。先理解輸入與輸出，才能診斷為何一個缺陷跨數道工序後才被發現。
guides.conceptEn: A process flow is more than a list. Each operation requires a particular surface, material or pattern state and must leave a usable state for the next operation. A repeated deposition or clean can serve different purposes at different layers. Tracking states helps explain why a defect may become visible several operations after it originated.
procedure: 選擇公開資料中的簡化 MOS 電晶體剖面，在自己的圖上用不同顏色標出基板、介電層、閘極、接觸與互連；註明圖不是比例尺，也不套用先進節點尺寸。
對每一層填寫「已有材料、要新增或移除的材料、保護區域、可用的量測」。例如介電層中的接觸開口需要圖案轉移，但開口存在不代表接觸電阻已合格。
把沉積、塗阻、曝光、適用的曝光後烘烤、顯影、蝕刻、去阻與量測接成有向圖。只加入具有物理依存的箭頭；依選定光阻文件決定是否需要曝光後烘烤。
假設接觸開口底部有殘留，沿圖往前追查光阻殘膜、蝕刻不足與清洗不充分三種可能；為每一個假說指定能區分它的觀察，而不是只增加蝕刻時間。
在工作單保留「停止」與「待查證」節點。若材料相容性、量測方式或前後順序不明，記下要查的原始技術文件，避免把未知寫成既定配方。
procedureEn: Choose a simplified MOS cross-section from a public reference. Redraw substrate, dielectric, gate, contact and interconnect in different colors; label the drawing as not to scale and do not assign advanced-node dimensions.

For each layer, record existing material, material to add or remove, protected regions and an available measurement. A contact opening in a dielectric requires pattern transfer, but an opening alone does not establish acceptable contact resistance.

Connect deposition, coating, exposure, applicable post-exposure bake, development, etch, strip and inspection in a directed graph. Add only physical dependencies; determine whether a post-exposure bake applies from the selected resist documentation.

Assume residue remains at a contact bottom. Trace three hypotheses: resist scum, incomplete etch and inadequate cleaning. Specify an observation that distinguishes each hypothesis instead of simply extending etch time.

Keep stop and unresolved nodes in the worksheet. When compatibility, measurement or ordering is unknown, name the original technical document needed rather than treating an assumption as an established recipe.
evidence: 交付帶材料狀態的依存圖、三個可被觀察推翻的缺陷假說，以及來源表。合格判準是每條箭頭能解釋「為何必須先做」，不是圖上節點越多越好。
如果使用來源中的顯微圖，記錄材料、尺度、取樣位置與來源；不要把影片動畫當作量測證據。
evidenceEn: Deliver a material-state dependency graph, three falsifiable defect hypotheses and a reference table. Each arrow must explain why one action precedes another; a larger node count is not the success criterion.
For referenced micrographs, record material, scale, sampling location and provenance. Animation frames are not measurement evidence.
pitfalls: 把所有 CMOS 架構拼成同一片晶圓必經的流程。
看見圖案就假定材料、電性和污染全都合格。
pitfallsEn: Combining all CMOS architectures into one mandatory wafer route.
Assuming a visible pattern establishes material, electrical and contamination quality.

guides.title: 光阻不是顏料：建立曝光與顯影的判讀表
guides.titleEn: Photoresist is not paint: interpret exposure and development
guides.concept: 曝光改變光阻的化學狀態，顯影將這種差異轉成形狀。殘留、線寬偏差或倒塌可能來自塗膜、烘烤、曝光和顯影的交互影響。這份練習建立診斷方法，不提供化學品配製或機台設定。
guides.conceptEn: Exposure changes the chemical state of resist; development converts that difference into geometry. Residue, dimensional bias or collapse can involve coating, baking, exposure and development together. This exercise develops diagnosis rather than chemical formulations or equipment settings.
procedure: 先從所選光阻的官方說明辨認正型、負型或影像反轉模式。畫出曝光區與保留區；如果使用不同光阻，重新建立圖，不沿用原本的顯影方向。
建立一張欄為曝光條件、列為顯影條件的空白比較表，填入自行取得且具有相同膜厚與基材的資料。沒有資料時，只畫假說趨勢並明確標為預測。
對每格記錄開口是否清底、保留區剩餘膜厚、特徵寬度及缺陷類型。使用同一測量定義和位置，避免拿不同倍率或不同圖形密度的影像直接排名。
若開口殘留但保留區完整，提出曝光不足與顯影不足兩個假說；若兩區都過度損失，檢查選擇性、膜厚與烘烤狀態。用額外觀察排除假說，不一次改動所有因素。
圈出同時符合自己先訂判準的區域，標示其邊緣最容易失效的指標。用重複資料檢查穩健性；只有單張漂亮影像時，不宣稱已找到製程窗口。
procedureEn: Identify positive, negative or image-reversal operation from the selected resist documentation. Draw exposed and retained regions; rebuild this map when changing resist rather than reusing the previous development polarity.

Create an empty matrix of exposure versus development conditions. Populate it with data you obtain for consistent film thickness and substrate. Without data, draw only clearly labeled hypothetical trends.

Record opening clearance, retained-film thickness, feature width and defect type for each cell. Use consistent measurement definitions and locations; do not directly rank images taken at different magnifications or pattern densities.

For residue in openings with intact retained resist, propose underexposure and underdevelopment as separate hypotheses. If both regions erode excessively, examine selectivity, thickness and bake state. Discriminate hypotheses with additional observations rather than changing every factor.

Identify regions meeting criteria you defined in advance and note the metric most likely to fail at each boundary. Assess robustness using repeat data; one attractive image does not establish a process window.
evidence: 提交附資料來源的比較表，或明確標為假說的空白計畫；列出至少一個能區分兩個成因的觀察。
說明正負型光阻保留區的差異，以及為何清底與保留膜厚必須同時檢查。
evidenceEn: Submit a comparison matrix with data provenance, or an explicitly hypothetical study plan; include an observation that separates two potential causes.
Explain retained-region polarity and why opening clearance and remaining film thickness must be checked together.
pitfalls: 把正型光阻的曝光效果直接套到所有負型材料。
只求開口清空而忽略遮罩膜厚被消耗。
把廠商示例參數當成未知材料可直接使用的設定。
pitfallsEn: Applying positive-resist exposure behavior to every negative material.
Clearing openings while ignoring loss of masking thickness.
Treating a supplier example as a usable setting for an unspecified material.

guides.title: 半導體製程工藝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.concept: 先用「建立 CMOS 剖面層序」建立判讀邊界。閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 對應操作：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build the CMOS cross-section stack to define the interpretation boundary. A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立 CMOS 剖面層序：保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
觀察站 2｜延伸接面剖面建模：觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
觀察站 3｜良品晶圓製造交接：觀察與驗證重點：接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build the CMOS cross-section stack: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.

Observation station 2 | Model extension-junction profiles: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.

Observation station 3 | Handoff qualified wafers: Observation and validation target: the receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「延伸接面剖面建模」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「良品晶圓製造交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model extension-junction profiles: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Handoff qualified wafers to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
Diagnostic consideration: peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary:
1987 年，台積電以專業晶圓代工模式成立，把替客戶製造晶片作為核心業務。這個故事不只關於一座工廠，更關於設計與製造如何透過規格、製程能力與交付品質協作。新竹的台積創新館提供理解這段產業分工歷史的公共窗口。

本課程從這個地點延伸到晶圓上一層層圖形與材料的形成：某道工序的輸出，會成為下一道工序的條件。地圖標示的是博物館與產業聚落的代表點，並非所有製程的唯一生產地；課程的分步模型也不是台積電未公開的製造配方。
courses.summaryEn:
TSMC was established in 1987 around a dedicated foundry model, focusing on manufacturing customers’ chips. The story concerns more than a factory: it shows how design and manufacturing cooperate through specifications, process capabilities, and delivered quality. The TSMC Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu provides a public window into that industrial division of work.

The course extends this setting into the formation of successive material layers and patterns on a wafer. Each operation supplies conditions for the next. The map marks a museum and industry-cluster reference point, not the sole location of semiconductor production; the educational sequence is not TSMC’s undisclosed manufacturing recipe.

history.title: 專業晶圓代工模式起步
history.text: 張忠謀創辦台積電，專注於製造客戶的晶片，形成設計與製造分工的代表案例。
history.textEn: Morris Chang established TSMC with a focus on manufacturing customers’ chips, creating a prominent case of design–manufacturing specialization.

history.title: 創新館五週年
history.titleEn: The museum marks its fifth anniversary
history.text: 台積創新館發布五週年活動，顯示這段企業與半導體產業故事也透過公共展示傳承。
history.textEn: The museum announced fifth-anniversary activities, illustrating how this company and industry history is shared through public exhibitions.

courses.connection: 以博物館認識產業分工，再回到課程比較微影、蝕刻、薄膜、平坦化與量測的前後依賴。練習區分「設計意圖」「製造結果」及「驗證證據」。
courses.connectionEn: Use the museum to understand industrial specialization, then compare dependencies among patterning, etching, films, planarization, and measurement. Distinguish design intent, manufacturing outcome, and verification evidence.
